transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We've got three mandatory training sessions to get on the schedule in the next three workdays: forklift-operator certification, generator-operator refresher, and hazardous-materials handling refresher. Each one needs a two-hour block. Before I sign off on the schedule, I need updates from each of you. Training NCO, what's the status on forklift-operator certification? Motor pool sergeant, where do we stand on the generator-operator refresher? And safety officer, what's the latest on the hazmat handling refresher? Let's hear what you've got so we can lock this in.
